description: List transactions for an address. type controls which list: "normal" (regular EOA txs), "internal" (contract-internal value transfers), "erc20" (ERC-20 transfers), "erc721" (NFT transfers), "erc1155" (multi-token transfers).

chain.description: Chain slug or chain ID (default ethereum)

type.description: normal | internal | erc20 | erc721 | erc1155 (default normal)

name: list_transactions
